summary.text: Michael Orth is the Republican candidate for the Oregon House of Representatives, District 36, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Hai Pham (D).
In a Ballotpedia survey, Orth described himself as a native Oregonian who opposes new and higher taxes.

paragraphs.text: Michael Orth graduated from LaSalle High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Portland in 1976.
He advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.
In his survey, he listed lower taxes and fees, increased school hours, reinstating graduation requirements, school choice, and full funding and support for law enforcement among his key messages.
